item.title: Morning brief, Tuesday November 24
item.description: Good morning Sydney, happy Tuesday. Before you open Instagram or TikTok: if your F1 Vegas recap reel isn't up yet, edit it and post it this morning, then add a cozy Colorado good morning story, and spend about thirty to sixty minutes replying to comments and messages. Your one big thing today is getting that reel live, then one focused hour to clear your loose ends so the rest of Thanksgiving week is fully off. Top must-dos: reply to Tina on Vrbo, since she wants to see the house tonight while you're in Colorado. Pay the UPS import fee on your shipment from Paris, which is now in transit. And send Elizabeth your hotel and room service receipts for your reimbursement. Also, the home security hub at the Venice house went offline last night, so ask someone to check on it. Your calendar is clear today. Tomorrow, Gabe has his call with Ahmad at three Mountain. Weather in Denver: sunny and cold this morning, around thirty seven at nine, warming to about fifty this afternoon. No flights in the next few days. Have a great day.
